effects_provenance.raw: Blue Dream 28g (1 oz) Blue Dream is a sativa dominant hybrid made by crossing Blueberry and Haze. This strain known for its balanced and cerebral effects and full-body relaxation. It has gained a strong following in the cannabis community due to its well-rounded qualities. Blue Dream's exact breeder remains somewhat uncertain, but it is widely believed to be the creation of Santa Cruz-based breeder DJ Short, who is renowned for his work in the cannabis industry. The strain's genetics are linked to DJ Short's Blueberry and a Haze strain, resulting in a hybrid known for its harmonious effects. Blue Dream's aroma is often described as a harmonious blend of earthy, fruity, and floral notes. When you take a whiff, you may detect hints of sweet berries, followed by a subtle earthiness that rounds out the scent. The aroma is inviting and captivating, making Blue Dream one of the most sought-after strains for its pleasant fragrance. The flavor profile of Blue Dream mirrors its aroma. It typically offers a delightful mix of sweet blueberry, floral undertones, and a mild earthy note on the exhale. These flavors make it an appealing choice for those who appreciate a pleasant taste while enjoying its balanced effects. Featured Flower Sativa Type 1 Flow Gardens

It’s the perfect mix of two incredible parent strains: Sunset Sherbet and Thin Mint Girl Scout Cookies. Gelato is the best of both worlds! It’s an Indica-dominant hybrid—56 % indica, 44% Sativa—which means it offers relaxation while also having that Sativa-focused kick. Whether you’re new to cannabis or a seasoned pro, it’s the kind of strain that leaves you wanting more every single time! Strain Effects Euphoric high Uplifting Creative Relaxing effects Happy Focused THC Level The THC level for this Indica-dominant hybrid is 14.41%. Its mildy high THC content can be attributed to the densely populated trichomes adding to the potency of this excellent cannabis bud. The strain’s potency adds to its appeal for cannabis enthusiasts. Aroma & Flavor Profile Gelato is a sweet and fruity mix with a hint of gas, drawing you closer with its irresistible aroma. It has been described as a scoop of sherbet reminiscent of blueberry and orange flavors. As you inhale, it’s like entering a world filled with lavender, citrus, and berries! When you break apart the nugs and light up, a subtle woody note enhances your overall smoking experience. It’s like taking a flavorful journey with every puff! Appearance At first glance, gelato has slightly dense, dark purple buds with super bright pistil orange hairs covered in thick, crystal-like trichomes. Trichomes are the good stuff, containing cannabinoids and terpenes that give Gelato its high-quality, distinct flavor and potency! Terpene Profile Limonene Limonene is responsible for the weed strains’ berry, citrus, and fruity flavors. Limonene creates an uplifting and euphoric feeling in cannabis. Myrcene Myrcene gives an earthy and musky aroma, complementing and collaborating with the other terpenes. This terpene is considered one of the most relaxing in how it affects people. Myrcene is found in all indica strains and offers relaxation and aids muscle spasms and chronic pain. Caryophyllene Caryophyllene terpene is known for its spicy and pepper flavor and aroma. Caryophyllene offers anti-inflammatory and anti-anxiety effects that can contribute to the therapeutic and sensory effects.
